plugin.name: Arcade Machine
plugin.description: Office Wordle, live drawing rooms, daily Sudoku inside your IDE. Native Swing compatibility edition for JetBrains IDEs 2019.1–2019.3, with Java 8 support. Requires the office Arcade Machine server.
plugin.change-notes:
A colorful new three-game menu: mint Wordle, coral Drawing and blue Sudoku. Refreshed game surfaces, clear controls and readable light/dark themes.

Higher / Lower has been removed from the client, server and rankings. Update the server and plugins together. Existing player data and progress in the remaining games are preserved.
